notes.title: Our new game is out!
notes.content:
[h2]Great news! Our more recent BL Visual Novel, [i][b]Lurkers[/b][/i], was released yesterday![/h2]

[i][b]Lurkers[/b][/i] is a short thriller revolving around the Jack the Ripper crimes. It features around 35k words, two suspects, three love interests, one bad ending if you choose the wrong culprit, and one good ending plus additional conclusions with the love interest of your choice, or a solo/friendship conclusion if you prefer. The rating is 15+.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016683/2eaf8fc900cc69941dd478171fc65a9be9d00489.png[/img]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376840/Lurkers/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376840/Lurkers/[/url][/h2]

Come and have a taste of the grimmest side of Victorian England!

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
All the minor bugs in the game have been now cleaned! 

Please, leave a comment if you find any other remaining issue. I've also added the "bara" tag to the store page so people are more aware of what kind of game this is (not only a Visual Novel, but a bara one).

For the ones who commented they would like more content like this from Ertal Games... I'm sorry, but bara is not really my cup of tea, hahaha! I just wanted to make a short game about gladiators, since I live in a town with a huge Roman heritage and I've seen many gladiators reenactments in my life, and they are really cool!

However, you can follow the artist's itchio, since he specializes in bara art and sometimes collaborates with other indie game devs; I'm sure you will find interesting stuff! [url=https://wolfscade.itch.io/]https://wolfscade.itch.io/[/url]

Thank you again for playing Blood and Lust! Don't forget to leave a review if you like it, even if it just says "nice game" ːsteammockingː
